cases.summary: Agent is logged out after the configured inactivity period with no touch
cases.preconditions: Logged in on staging with EnvConfig inventory agent (PDV) after PIN validation; inactivity minutes named in EnvConfig testData.session.inactivityTimeoutMinutes
cases.input: 1. Leave the app open with no action and no screen touch for the configured minutes.
cases.expected: Agent is automatically logged out after that period.
cases.traceability: SAA-911; REQ-001; automatically logged out after a given period of time

cases.summary: A screen touch before the period resets inactivity
cases.input: 1. Wait until just before the timeout. 2. Touch the screen. 3. Wait the same period again without timeout.
cases.expected: The agent remains logged in after the first interval because of the touch. Logout still occurs after a full untouched period.
cases.traceability: SAA-911; REQ-003; no action on the app, nor touch the screen

cases.summary: Returning to the app before the period ends does not require a new login
cases.preconditions: Logged in on staging with EnvConfig inventory agent (PDV) after PIN validation
cases.input: 1. Send the app to background for a few seconds (well below any configured timeout). 2. Re-open the agent app.
cases.expected: The agent re-enters without logging in.
cases.traceability: SAA-911; REQ-005; able to reenter the agent app without login in, if the time is not yet up

cases.summary: Timeout continues while the app is in the background
cases.input: 1. Background the app. 2. Wait until the configured period has elapsed. 3. Re-open the app.
cases.expected: The agent is logged out. Timeout applied even when the user left the app.
cases.traceability: SAA-911; REQ-004, REQ-001; should apply, even when user leaves the app

cases.input: 1. Stay inactive until just before the configured minute. 2. Repeat until the configured minute has elapsed.
cases.expected: Still logged in just before. Logged out at or after the period. Record whether logout is exact or on next interaction (Q-003).
cases.traceability: SAA-911; REQ-001; given period of time

cases.summary: Screen shown after automatic logout is not stated
cases.input: 1. Observe the destination screen and any message.
cases.expected: Cannot be expected-resulted. Destination (MSISDN, PIN, or splash) and message are not in the ticket.

cases.summary: Timeout is configurable in minutes per profile
cases.input: 1. Locate inactivity timeout in minutes per profile.
cases.expected: Not testable from the mobile app. No portal steps are in the ticket.
cases.traceability: SAA-911; REQ-002; manageable through the admin portal
